data.title: Golf Views
data.about:
Welcome to Golf Views in Emaar South. With magnificent views of the golf course, Golf Views offer your stylish 1, 2, 3 bedroom apartments with the best amenities. Take a walk through the beautiful pathways, take a swing at the golf course or chill in plazas.

Residents of Golf Views will have access to schools, hotels, retail centres, parks, and amazing views. It is a family-friendly community located just minutes from the top entertainment and leisure attractions of the city. Live the resort lifestyle at Golf Views.
